mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 44 degrees and clear at Verona Community Park, with the air quality index at a moderate 52 and a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon to start the morning.

City news today includes the Senior Center offering nutritious meal programs for our residents, plus ongoing updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction project where utility work is finished and concrete work continues on the west block.

There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, plus ART House 360 and Hop Haus trivia rounds out your evening, while tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I during transport, though fortunately no injuries were reported.
For dessert, today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
